description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Verizon is building an internal API Gateway platform for a global network engineering organization. The Engineer - Full Stack will develop APIs, user interfaces, and AI agents that support network operations and infrastructure decisions, owning features end to end.
Full-Stack Engineer owning network-operations application lifecycle across Node.js/Postgres APIs, Vue.js dashboards, and MCP AI agents

Responsibilities:
• Designing and build REST APIs (Node.js) against Postgres, with versioning, input schemas, caching, and hybrid NP/prod auth models
• Building widgets and Vue.js views that surface network inventory and operational metrics (counts dashboards, site status, work-item boards)
• Configuring and extending AI agents (MCP servers, tool bindings, prompt design) that assist network engineers with day-to-day ops
• Modelling relational data for work-item tracking, project management, and CMDB-adjacent inventory
• Owning the full lifecycle: schema migration → API → widget → agent tool → PR → prod deploy
• Debugging across the stack: platform security policies, credential vaults, DB pool exhaustion, agent tool-call failures
• Collaborating with network engineers to translate ops asks ("we need a counts page showing X Nexus, Y Pica8") into shipped features

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree or one or more years of relevant work experience
• One or more years of relevant work experience, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training
• Experience in JavaScript/Node.js — async patterns, REST handler design, error handling
• Experience with AI agents / LLM tool-use patterns (MCP, function calling, agent orchestration)
• Frontend fundamentals — Vue.js (or React), HTML/CSS, browser networking, state management for dashboards

Preferred:
• Network engineering domain knowledge (Cisco Nexus, Pica8, Arista, NAC, VXLAN, data center refresh workflows)
• Strong SQL and relational modeling — Postgres preferred; comfortable writing migrations, joins, and parameterized queries
• API design discipline — input validation, versioning, idempotency, auth, rate limiting
• Git workflow proficiency — branching, PR hygiene, disciplined commits, comfortable with staged/unstaged distinctions
• Debugging across boundaries — reading platform errors, tracing failures from UI → API → DB → external system
• Security-aware coding — credential vaults, secrets handling, least privilege, understanding prod vs non-prod boundaries
• Clear written communication — turning fuzzy asks into scoped work items; documentation others can act on
• Project management systems (PMO, epics/stories/tasks) and integrations with them
• Prior work on internal developer platforms or low-code/API-gateway tooling
• Experience with ServiceNow, CMDB, or IT asset management systems
